question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Aurelia Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Cadenza Aria 1x Skill or Canon Chorus 5x UltraSkill_Damage + 1x UltraSkill_Damage2, jellyfish tracking, or projectile enhancement.
decision: Cadenza Aria describes 1 instance totaling 100.0% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Mitsuki_Skill_Damage. Canon Chorus describes 6 instances totaling 89.0%*5 + 55.2% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_Damage (5 hits) and GE_Player_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_Damage2 (1 hit). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; Cadenza state (12s, +15% Crit Rate at A1), A3 UltraSkill DMG bonus (+20%), and A5 UltraSkill Crit Rate (+15%) apply consistently across all burst hits.
timing_hypothesis: aurelia.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 500/1, 857/1, 1851/2; Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 2501/1, 8571/2, 27771/5 (with Cadenza A3 +20% dmg bonus).
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 8 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, jellyfish tracking, projectile enhancement, AoE coverage and full awakening mechanics remain pending.
